whipFloor.title: Floor Update – 6 Votes
whipFloor.body:
The House is now taking the following votes. At approximately PLACEHOLDER_START the House will consider the remaining measures: 

  1. On Ordering the Previous Question of H. Res. 1203 – Providing for consideration of the Senate Amendments to H.R. 3590 , Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, and providing for the consideration of the bill H.R. 4872, Reconciliation Act of 2010. – 15 minutes
  2. On Agreeing to the Resolution of H. Res. 1203 – Providing for consideration of the Senate Amendments to H.R. 3590 , Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, and providing for the consideration of the bill H.R. 4872, Reconciliation Act of 2010. – 15 minutes
  3. On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree, as Amended of H. Res. 925 – Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives regarding the meritorious service performed by aviators in the United States Armed Forces who were shot down over, or otherwise forced to land in, hostile territory yet evaded enemy capture or were captured buy subsequently escaped – 15 minutes
  4. On Motion to Concur in Senate Amendments of H.R. 3590 – Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act – 15 minutes
  5. On Motion to Recommit with Instructions of H.R. 4872 – Reconciliation Act of 2010 – 15 minutes
  6. On Passage of H.R. 4872 – Reconciliation Act of 2010 – 15 minutes
